svg.text: STM32 Environmental Sensor Node — Wiring Diagram
NUCLEO-F446RE · BME280 · SSD1306/SH1106 OLED · shared I²C1 bus (PB8 = SCL, PB9 = SDA) @ 3.3 V
Both modules share one I²C1 bus. A wire drawn along a row is the jumper tying those breadboard columns together.
The two 4.7 kΩ resistors pull SCL and SDA up to the +3.3 V rail.
